# What seed-cold-start-fixture's Delta Lake generator imports: pyspark and delta-spark.
#
# Every package and dependency at an exact version, with the SHA-256 of each file PyPI serves
# for it, installed as
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-build-isolation --only-binary=:all: --no-binary=pyspark -r "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../../requirements/cold_start_fixture.txt"
# so pip installs these files and nothing else. uv cannot read pyspark's dependencies without
# building its sdist, so this file is the dependencies compiled from pyspark's one dependency
# and delta-spark's other,
#   printf 'py4j==0.10.9.7\nimportlib_metadata>=1.0.0\n' | uv pip compile - --universal \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header --no-annotate --python-version 3.11 \
#     --exclude-newer <a date two weeks back>
# with pyspark==3.5.5 and delta-spark==3.3.2 added by hand, at the hashes PyPI's JSON API lists
# (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json). --exclude-newer keeps each dependency to a
# release at least two weeks old.
